tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary only one input and do not identify the proposed two-layer bridge. An open-branch discriminating probe is warranted before fitting and confirming a quantitative law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a thermal-fin or coupled siphon model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies, leaving the coupled mechanism and its dependence on the other inputs unidentified.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly targets the unresolved mechanism.
The pilot response saturates as u_now increases, and the bridge signature points to a coupled alternative; neither recalled note is sufficiently established by these rows.
It is not relevant to resolving the mechanism.
